description: Submit a new editorial list (e.g. "Top 10 AI dev-tools startups", "Best seed-stage fintech companies") to StartupHub.ai for moderation review. Lists are collections of existing startups, investors, and/or people on the site: provide their slugs. Optional rich content (HTML or text body) for the list article. Lands as status=pending; admin must approve before public. Costs 5 credits. Use search_startups / search_investors / search_people to look up slugs first. Needs a free StartupHub.ai account.

content.description: Optional long-form body. Plain text or simple HTML. ≤5000 words. Third-person.

excerpt.description: Short summary shown on list index + SEO description (≤400 chars, third-person).

investor_slugs.description: Array of investor slugs to include.

people_slugs.description: Array of person slugs to include.

source_url.description: Optional URL to the original source if syndicating.

startup_slugs.description: Array of startup slugs to include. Must match existing profiles. Look up via search_startups.

name: submit_list
title: Submit a list
